description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2023: Measuring Settlement with Laser Lines after Soil Liquefaction is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jason DeJong, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). This research expands the development of a new image analysis method used for measuring settlement in soil models to work for saturated soils. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-k78t-5f49. Keywords: NHERI Center for Geotechnical Modeling; Displacement; Settlement; Liquefaction; Cameras; Lasers. Published 2023-09-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
